population: Audited fake-favorite gate: F1 AND F2, exact trio-market favorite baseline.

rule.name: positive_count_then_sum
rule.favorite: Let exact 3連複 #1 favorite be A-B-C.
rule.pair_score: For each favorite pair, inspect pair+X for every actual outsider X. Primary score = count(delta>0). First tie-break = sum of positive delta. Second tie-break = sum of all delta. Final deterministic tie-break = lower car-number tuple.
rule.axis: Choose the highest-scoring favorite pair as the 2-car axis.
rule.drop: Drop the one member of the original favorite not contained in the selected axis.
rule.two_head_flow: Buy axis + every actual outsider only. Never buy the dropped favorite member as third car, so the original #1 favorite ticket is never bought.
rule.four_car_box: Choose the two outsiders with the highest pair-specific delta for the selected axis. Form a 4-car BOX from selected axis + those two outsiders. The dropped favorite member is excluded, so the original #1 favorite ticket is never bought.
rule.stake: 100 yen per unique trio ticket; no dutching.

discipline: Apply this rule unchanged to 2024. Do not alter scoring order, tie-breaks, outsider selection, ticket structure, or staking after seeing 2024 results.
